newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-IRISH FACE HOOKING DILEMMA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-IRISH FACE HOOKING DILEMMA.

text.p: New Zealand-born hooker Ross Nesdale could make his Irish debut against Wales in the Five Nations championship at Cardiff Arms Park next Saturday.

Ireland, forced to find a new hooker after Keith Wood was ruled out for the season, named Northampton's Allen Clarke to fill the gap on Sunday despite receiving reports he had broken a finger playing for his club on Saturday.

If Clarke is unable to play, Newcastle's Nesdale is likely to be promoted from the replacements' bench to win his first cap. Jim Staples, back at full-back after injury, takes over from Wood as captain.

15-Jim Staples (captain); 14-James Topping, 13-Jonathan Bell, 12-Maurice Field, 11-Dominic Crotty; 10-Eric Elwood, 9-Niall Hogan; 8-Eric Miller, 7-Denis McBride, 6-David Corkery, 5-Jeremy Davidson, 4-Paddy Johns, 3-Paul Wallace, 2-Allen Clarke, 1-Nick Popplewell.
